clues.text: Moses warned Pharaoh that unless Israel went free, Egyptian houses and even the ground would be full of these.
When God sent swarms of these on Egypt, none were found in Goshen, where His people lived.
While swarms of these filled Egypt, Pharaoh told Moses and Aaron to sacrifice to their God within the land.
After Moses prayed, the LORD took these away from Pharaoh and his people until not one remained.
Plagued by swarms of these, Pharaoh let Israel go sacrifice in the wilderness, but not very far, and asked Moses to pray.
The Teacher said dead ones bring a stench to the perfumer's oil, as a little folly outweighs wisdom.
Isaiah said the LORD would whistle for these from the farthest streams of the Nile, and for bees from Assyria.
